comparators_or_controls: Fair 50% expectation, same-device blank, two-way donor exchange, sham and restoration, raw Hamming nearest neighbor and implementation-independent arithmetic histogram twin. Score each law and convention.
controls_version: exact receiver interventions; blind actions fixed before scoring
decision_rule: Positive panel requires above-half accuracy and control by the learned state (all shams, restorations, donor matches, with changed predictions on original disagreements). Full transfer in a cell requires all classifications correct. Partition mean, class counts and histogram support qualify any effect.
first_executable_signal: Feeder predecessor's reproducible cue reversal motivates a prospectively frozen acquisition test. Before release two synthetic non-panel patterns exercise real updates, different held guesses and reciprocal transfers under each relation.
forbidden_inputs: Class string, template, pose, generator metadata, row ID or position in the schedule, prepared letter feature, external image encoder, scorer key, future rewards, saved numeric classifier parameters supplied to the knot reader.

images.poses: 25 anchors x four clockwise quarter-turns x two styles x two letters

inputs: 64 raw row-major bits; a single learner-issued bit and training correctness, once per bitmap.
mapping: Uniform zero-padded two-by-two raw windows, 16 shared addresses, two banks of 16 physical count words. Add to the rewarded action; read closest mean by exact squared Euclidean discrepancy. Both ternary laws checked on their runtime support. Blank or tie goes to bit zero.
nonclaims: A chosen sensor, write schedule, code and arithmetic readout are supplied. A limited glyph census and a matching integer device cannot establish general vision, learned wiring, or a computational benefit peculiar to knots.
outputs: One binary action. Ordinary 0=L and 1=T. Reverse both meanings only in the separately trained opposite convention.
primary_observable: Correct/total by condition and class plus causal changes on a fixed image from cleared and exchanged knot registers. Novel and training-seen histogram counts.
question: Does correct/incorrect feedback on raw 8 by 8 L/T images produce knot-held associations that control fresh decisions and survive held positions or quarter-turns?
resource_budget: 64 once-only presentations per fit; 4 physical fits, 2 integer twins, 1 Hamming fit; complete 336 test bitmaps unchanged. CPU, single process per phase; no search or additional fit. Each physical fit retains 416 ternary holdings.
seals: Contract binds code, images, separate answer keys. A fit release binds physical states and a blind release binds all predictions. Independent phase locks are recorded before the following phase.
stop_rule: Complete these four panels and causal controls once and stop at the strongest bounded result or first concrete limitation. No post-score tuning.
